ticket.title: Scaffold aerofoil-1090 and implement CRC-24 parity division
ticket.description: Scaffold aerofoil-1090 crate and implement Mode S 24-bit CRC polynomial division (0x1FFF409) with precomputed 256-word table for short (56-bit) and long (112-bit) frames.
acceptance_criteria: aerofoil-1090 added to workspace as no_std core with aerofoil-common dependency
CRC-24 syndrome division over polynomial 0x1FFF409 using 256-entry lookup table
Zero dynamic heap allocation on frame evaluation
Verified against ICAO Annex 10 test vectors
